<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope, the peaks are spaced by ~1.003 Da, which is the characteristic mass difference between ^12C and ^13C. This pattern is strong enough to definitively identify carbon. No other element shows its distinctive isotopic spacing (e.g., Cl, Br, S), so carbon is the only element we can confirm.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
